items.title: Indian TV coverage of Nepal floods criticised for sensationalism
items.summary: Residents say some crews have turned their own difficulties at disaster sites into television drama and given less attention to those flood victims.

items.title: Decade-old alternative to a vital Prithvi Highway link remains on paper
items.summary: The collapse-prone Krishnabhir section of the Prithvi Highway has exposed the lack of a parallel route on the other side of the Trishuli river, despite plans dating back nearly a decade.

items.title: Prime Minister Shah to highlight Nepal’s outsized climate burden at UN
items.summary: Following devastating Bhotekoshi floods, Shah will press for financial support to help Nepal recover and build climate resilience.

items.title: Nepal estimates Rs2.34 billion to rebuild flood-hit education sector
items.summary: Eighteen schools were affected in Rasuwa, disrupting classes for more than 9,000 students after the August 26 Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: Nepal prepares Krishnabhir bypass as temporary fix remains uncertain
items.summary: Officials are upgrading a 12-km road along the opposite bank of the Trishuli river as the landslide-prone Krishnabhir section of the Prithvi Highway remains closed.
